dialogues.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
dialogues.text: Meow... It's already time for the tea party, meow. I wonder if they're lost, meow...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Golden Traveler. You must be the chosen hero, meow! Would you help me look for my friends?

choices.text: And who might your friends be...?

response.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
response.text: Oh, and of the two ladies who aren't here yet, one is a kitty that can talk just like me. But unlike me, she's an orange tabby, meow.

response.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
response.text: My other friend is a very polite lady poodle. A canine, true, but a most genteel one nevertheless, meow.

response.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
response.text: Even though one of them's a cat and the other, a dog, whenever we sit down for tea together, we always have a wonderful time, meow!

response.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
response.text: Please, for the peace of Meouranopolis, lend me a paw, meow!

choices.text: Wow, it's really easy to be a "hero" these days, huh?

response.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
response.text: Oh, let's not quibble too much over the details, meow. If you already have the holy sword of legend, a hero is a hero, whether you find the Pure Grail they speak of or not, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
dialogues.text: This is where we agreed to meet... but my friends still haven't arrived, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
dialogues.text: Our chosen hero, would you mind helping me look around for them?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
dialogues.text: This is where we agreed to meet... but my friends still haven't arrived, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
dialogues.text: Our chosen hero, would you mind helping me look around for them?

dialogues.speaker: Miss Tabby
dialogues.text: ...Meow. Your swordsmanship... leaves quite the impression.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Tabby
dialogues.text: My thanks to you, esteemed knight from lands afar. Those arrogant brutes won't be troubling my people's homes ever again.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Tabby
dialogues.text: Now then... what brings you to my court?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Since this is a fairy tale, this must also be part of that fairy tale world, then?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: On behalf of Mr. Gray Cat, you extend an invitation to his tea party to the lady tabby...

response.speaker: Miss Tabby
response.text: ...I understand, and you have my thanks, esteemed knight from lands afar. I shall heed your wise counsel and set forth at once.

choices.text: Your Majesty, allow me to report a matter to you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem, someone sure came around fast! Guess you just mind the local ways when "abroad"...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Lady Poodle
dialogues.text: #Woof? What is it, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Golden Traveler? Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: On behalf of Mr. Gray Cat, you extend an invitation to his tea party to Miss Lady Poodle...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Lady Poodle
dialogues.text: Thank you, woof! If I weren't so busy, I'd have gone to invite Miss Tabby myself... If I'd done that, perhaps Mr. Gray Cat might have...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Lady Poodle
dialogues.text: Cat or dog, we are all capable of getting along in peace... Yes, we can. Anyway, I should head to the tea party now. Thank you for the reminder!

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Gray Cat
dialogues.text: #Meow! Everyone is finally here, meow! Thanks to you, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Golden Traveler, our happy tea party can finally begin, meow!

dialogues.speaker: Miss Lady Poodle
dialogues.text: Why the long face, Miss Tabby? Have something sweet, and you'll find your spirits lifting in no time!
